image_description: A side-profile view of a large, dark brown bison walking on a gravelly bank near water. A second bison is partially visible in the background to the left. The main subject displays a prominent shoulder hump, shaggy forequarters, and a darker, less furry hindquarter. The head is lowered slightly, showing a beard and short horns.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile. It is broad and massive. Short, curved horns are distinctly visible protruding from the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison beard.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, though small due to distance and fur.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head/neck region.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive, heavy build. The withers (shoulder area) are significantly higher than the hips, creating the characteristic sloping back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a very clear textural difference between the front and back. The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur that forms a high, rounded hump.
The rear half of the body has visibly shorter, smoother fur compared to the shaggy front, exposing the underlying muscle shape more clearly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are small and curved, appearing proportionally short relative to the massive size of the head and body.
The visible legs are thick and sturdy. While the hooves are partially obscured by shadow and ground texture, the leg structure is correct and ends in dark, blocky shapes consistent with hooves.
A short tail ending in a dark, bushy tuft is visible hanging down behind the hind legs.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out hybrid or generic bovid errors.
To verify the structural integrity of the four-legged stance and ensure no limb fusion or extra limbs.
To check for edge bleeding between the shaggy fur and the background, especially around the complex beard and hump.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the fur.

focus_areas: Transition zone between shaggy forequarters and smooth hindquarters
Edge sharpness of the beard against the background
Anatomical correctness of the shoulder hump
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the shaggy front fur and the smoother rear fur. AI often blurs this boundary or makes it too abrupt. Also, verify that the legs do not 'melt' into the ground or each other, as the dark color of the bison against the shadowed ground can hide fusion artifacts.
